name: Special Investigator
source:
You play as Valerie, a sex-worker that also serves as a consultant with the local PD in sex crimes investigations.

In addition to having to serve multiple customers at the local strip club, she is also tasked with doing the "dirty" work that no respectful officer would ever do.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/hylogens]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演瓦莱丽，一名同时担任当地警察局性犯罪调查顾问的性工作者。

除了要在当地脱衣舞俱乐部接待多名客人，她还被要求去做那些任何体面警察都不会做的“脏活”。

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/hylogens]Patreon[/url]]
